verdict.rationale: Dagster is an orchestration framework that can trigger and sequence syncs from tools like Airbyte, Fivetran, and dlt (dagster-docs-8, dagster-docs-9, dagster-docs-10), but the evidence never shows Dagster itself performing incremental extraction with cursor/state tracking to avoid full reloads — that logic lives in the integrated EL tools, not in Dagster's own asset/partition system. No documentation describes native cursor management or change-data-capture behavior within Dagster's asset framework.
